You will mainly work at weekends, but it is also possible to deliver the leaflets in your neighbourhood on Mondays. Sometimes you will also have an extra delivery slot, for example for a magazine. You will walk or cycle your route at your own pace and ensure that every package ends up in the right place. 
 What you bring 
For this position, it is important that you work independently and accurately. You do not miss any addresses and can handle changes in the schedule well. You are fit enough to walk or cycle longer distances and lifting parcels is easy for you. It is also useful if you speak and understand Dutch and/or English so that you can follow communication and instructions properly.
